
### Which file do I need?

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Linux** | `Nachtzug-x86_64.AppImage` | Make it runnable (`chmod +x Nachtzug-x86_64.AppImage`, or tick “Allow executing as program” in its properties) and double-click it. Runs on distributions from 2025 on. |
| **Mac** with Apple Silicon, macOS 15 or newer | `Nachtzug-macOS.dmg` | Open it and drag Nachtzug into Applications. The first time, macOS says it can’t check Nachtzug for malware, because it isn’t signed by a registered Apple developer: click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. |
| **Windows** 10 or 11 | `Nachtzug-Windows-Setup.exe` | Run the installer. Windows may warn about an unknown publisher: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The Windows version is new, so please [tell me](https://github.com/mjohanning99/nachtzug/issues) if anything goes wrong. |

The manuals are here too, in English and German, and the source code if you’d like to build it yourself.
